Words by Hans Tse



On a scorching July weekend, thousands of people gathered in Hong Kong’s Tsim Sha Tsui shopping district to search for a rare Pokémon that could only be seen through the screen of a smartphone.



A man holds an infant baby and pose for photos with a costumed Pikachu in a shopping mall in Whampoa district, July 26, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/ HKFP.
